slots.label: Job type
slots.why: A job type is recurring work for a hired agent, not UI.

slots.label: Card
slots.why: A Home card is a data binding, not a design: the card UI takes the container and typography the skin sets.

slots.label: Help
slots.why: Help text has no look of its own: the Help UI that shows it is drawn with parts a skin styles.

slots.label: User account control
slots.why: An access policy decides who may do what; it has no look.
